title: Post-reversal turn probabilities from SAAV history in held-out worms
disposition_reason: A complete-panel preparation/scoring and F/I programme source exists for a specified processed-SAAV landmark task. Native animal/clock/SAAV admission and deployment remain unconfigured, so source completeness is not an executed held-worm benchmark.

scientific_target.question: At a fixed landmark while a worm is still reversing, how well does its preceding SAAV calcium history predict dorsal versus ventral post-reversal curvature in an entirely held-out worm?
scientific_target.known_answer: Binary direction: dorsal=1 if the mean dorsal-positive head curvature in the first two native frames after reversal end is positive, ventral=0 if negative; zero direction is an explicit source exclusion. This is a measured behavior target, not agreement with the paper narrative.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Operator-normalized WT aggregate records with independently verified physical clock, native frame map, dorsal orientation, SAAV identity and animal identity; the conversion and complete eligible animal count remain unqualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: One eligible maximal reversal episode, queried at the first native timestamp at least 2.4 seconds after reversal onset while still reversing.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Verified biological worm; all episodes and duplicate H5/MAT representations of that worm share the same outer fold.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective prediction from released processed SAAV traces. Whole-recording upstream processing prevents a claim of online causal availability. N/B/NB comparisons quantify predictive association under matched observed history, not the causal effect of SAAV.
exclusions: No reproduction claim for the paper phase-warped event-level GRU evaluation.
No independent-cohort claim relative to NEURAL-048.
No direct/no-tools or viewer understanding result; no new model trials.

inputs: Every contiguous native sample in the trailing 4.8 seconds ending at the landmark, with relative physical-time offsets.
N: SAAV calcium history; B: velocity and dorsal-positive curvature history; NB: the same behavior plus SAAV history. All views receive matched event support.
Training examples and labels from all other verified worms within each isolated outer fold; train-only inner animal folds for reference selection.
forbidden_inputs: Query turn labels, post-landmark behavior, reversal end/duration, odor observations, source identities/filenames and cross-fold fitted state.
Nominal frame rate substituted for verified physical time; phase-warped future-curvature alignment presented as causal.
observation_contract.case_identity: Prepared opaque case_<32 hex> event keys, group_<24 hex> animal aliases and fold_%03d names; HMAC-derived event IDs bind original recording/event identities privately. No authentic complete case census has been admitted.
observation_contract.split: Leave every eligible whole worm out once, minimum three independent eligible worms. Each training set must support both classes; all required folds and N/B/NB arms stay in the panel. Inner model selection uses only outer-training worms.
observation_contract.coverage: All selected WT aggregate source rows, maximal reversals and every eligible landmark event are required. Explicit no-SAAV recordings and prescribed censoring/missing-history/zero-direction exclusions are retained; an empty animal prevents complete-panel qualification. Actual eligible counts remain unknown.

primary.name: N animal-macro balanced accuracy at probability threshold 0.5
primary.aggregation: Mean of the two direction recalls within each worm, then equal mean over all eligible worms; one single-class worm makes complete-panel balanced accuracy undefined.
primary.rationale: Measures held-worm direction information without rewarding dominant direction or event-rich animals.

secondary: Co-primary N equal-animal binary log loss in nats with probability floor 1e-15.
All N/B/NB per-worm and macro log losses, balanced accuracies, class counts and paired arm contrasts; pooled-event loss is secondary only.
Complete support, exclusions, failures and reference-family outcomes; no favorable surviving-worm mean.

comparators.name: Behavior-only history
comparators.inputs: Same event windows, velocity and dorsal-positive curvature; no SAAV.
comparators.procedure: Same candidate family, fitting access and compute rules as N/NB; compare paired complete-worm outcomes.

comparators.name: Fixed and train-selected summary decoders
comparators.inputs: Last, mean, population SD, min, max and physical-time slope for each permitted channel.
comparators.procedure: Source fixes logistic C=1, inner-animal-selected logistic C in {0.01,0.1,1,10,100}, and a fixed HistGradientBoosting grid. Scaling and selection use training rows only; authentic reference competence is unqualified.

nuisance_controls: Use whole-worm grouping and matched behavioral windows to avoid event-level identity leakage.
Keep physical rather than phase-warped windows; retain whole-recording preprocessing exposure.
No future curvature, reversal-end timing or class-dependent sampling; direction support is reported for every worm.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source supplies 10,000 whole-worm bootstrap draws (seed 47047). Intervals are descriptive under overlapping training folds and exposed data; they do not estimate model-author or provider variation.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require complete unique case joins for every fold/arm and finite probabilities in [0,1]. Explicit abstention in any required fold/arm leaves the panel unscored and avoids private-target access. Missing classes leave balanced accuracy undefined while complete log loss remains reported.

implementation.scorer_target: legacy/scorer_core.py independently joins submitted dorsal probabilities to private post-reversal labels and computes absolute N/B/NB worm metrics. It measures behavior prediction, not source-table reconstruction.
implementation.delivered_scope: Full-conditional-programme-v3 source defines normalized-data preparation, F and I actors, three references, complete fold collection and target-last scoring. Its explicit landmark/SAAV/WT scope is narrower than unrestricted identified-neuron turn decoding.
missing: Qualified native WT export, complete animal/SAAV identity and clock/curvature orientation.
Configured deployment and independently observed isolation, full resource feasibility and authentic reference execution.
Delivered direct observation and typed image-viewer transports.
implementation.execution_evidence: Reviewed source and existing engineering provenance only. Deployment is explicitly unconfigured; no authentic model result is established here.
